headline: Weathered Expanse Slips Wardens' Grip as Callahan's Passage Rekindles
war_summary: Since our last edition the Wardens' foothold in the Weathered Expanse has vanished: no post they held there remains in their keeping, six stand Colonial and three in ruin, after thirty-three actions in the day, three inside two hours, Crow's Nest and Wightwalk the busiest grounds, and the day's losses running 4,767 Colonial against 8,121 Warden. Callahan's Passage has rekindled after its quiet spell, two strikes inside two hours and the last logged as this edition closed, twenty-two through the day, losses near 9,800 Colonial against 11,100 Warden, nine posts Warden-held and one Colonial. The Nevish Line, silent at our last going to press, has stirred anew, five actions in two hours and fifty-six through the day, Colonial holdings there doubled to two posts against six Warden. Palantine Berm still churns, forty actions with Leiri Hermanni struck twenty times, yet all seven posts hold for the Wardens, while Mooring County, so loud at our last edition, has gone still with its twelve. Marban Hollow has filed no base action since early evening despite deep losses, and eight of nine Stlican Shelf posts stand Colonial. It is day 491; thirty-four victory towns decide this war, and no victor is named.
